title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Agreement: One Plan per Customer
content:
**Clause.** A customer holds at most one CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan covering all of its registered instruments. A plan is not enrolled while the customer has a plan whose status is pending or active; a lapsed plan is reinstated rather than enrolled again.

## Effect of the clause

1. The limit is 1 plan per customer. That one plan covers every instrument the customer has registered; instruments are not split across two CalCare plans.
2. The bar on a new enrollment is read from the company's own plan records for the same customer: the customer's existing CalCare plans and the status each shows. What the customer says about an earlier plan does not replace that record.
3. The bar applies at the moment of enrollment, before the plan is enrolled.
4. Where the customer's earlier plan has lapsed, the plan is reinstated, not enrolled a second time.

## Status of an existing plan and its effect on a new enrollment

| Status of the customer's existing CalCare plan | New enrollment |
|---|---|
| pending | not enrolled |
| active | not enrolled |
| lapsed | not enrolled again; the lapsed plan is reinstated instead |

A cancelled plan is not one of the statuses this clause names.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a plan that has been enrolled but has not yet started count?* Yes. A plan in pending status bars a further enrollment exactly as an active plan does.
- *Is the one-plan limit counted per site or per instrument group?* No. The clause is per customer: one plan covering all of its registered instruments.
- *Hypothetical:* a customer whose only CalCare plan shows lapsed asks for a CalCare plan again. Under this clause the lapsed plan is reinstated rather than a second plan being enrolled.
